description.dum: Ruusbroecs traktaat voor een kloosterzuster over de Eucharistie en de standen van het innige leven. Middelnederlandse tekst van J. B. David (1860).
description.en-US: Ruusbroec's treatise, written for a nun, on Holy Communion and the stages of the interior life. The Middle Dutch text of J. B. David (1860).
description.pt-BR: Tratado de Ruusbroec, escrito para uma religiosa, sobre a Sagrada Comunhão e os graus da vida interior. Texto em neerlandês médio de J. B. David (1860).

sources.edition: Jan van Ruusbroec, Werken, ed. J. B. David, deel 3: Die spieghel der ewigher salicheit. (Gent: Maetschappy der Vlaemsche Bibliophilen, 1860).
sources.description: Keyed text from DBNL (TEI XML, 'auteursrechtvrij'), converted by research/sourcing/_scripts/rhineland/ruus_build.py. Line-end hyphens joined; page and line breaks dropped. David's apparatus is kept as footnotes (manuscript variants F, G, I, L, M, D, Surius' Latin readings 'Sur.'). David's Dutch preface, manuscript list, misprint list and glossary are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Nineteenth-century critical edition, marked 'Auteursrechtvrij' on DBNL.
